nodes.label: Localized Material Metadata Schema
nodes.rationale: Every material carries name, description and category as a mapping of locale keys (default, de, es, fr, pt, uk, zh_CN) rather than a single string, so the material library ships translations inline with the data instead of requiring a separate gettext catalog per material. 'default' acts as the fallback locale.

nodes.label: Material Appearance Schema
nodes.rationale: Materials describe their visual rendering with a hex color plus a named pattern token (solid, wood_grain, metallic). The pattern token is tied to the material category, letting the UI pick a shared texture renderer per family instead of storing per-material bitmaps.
